title: Mixture of Agents live success

install.basis: real candidate source checkout in its repository virtual environment

terminal.program: Talaria via POSIX PTY on macOS

expected.text: Real reference activity, progress, aggregation and completion track their events; reference text survives and the interface remains usable.

actual:
Four reviewed frame trios show real intermediate and completed states. All four rich event types were observed; unavailable-backend fallback is not credited as success.
Clause 1: pass: A real /moa turn emits five moa.progress, five moa.reference, one moa.phase and one moa.aggregating event. The first selected frame shows collecting2/5 and three pending references; pending is not portrayed as zero work. (https://github.com/infiquetra/talaria/issues/148)
Clause 2: pass: Reference text remains visible while aggregation starts. The real phase and aggregating payloads name openai-codex:gpt-5.6-sol; the live aggregation line displays that name. The final transcript and Inspector both report5/5 references aggregated by the same model. No no-aggregation-observed fallback is shown. (https://github.com/infiquetra/talaria/issues/148)
Clause 3: pass: The completed response gives three explanations of two plus two. The reference block remains above it; the working indicator has ended. All four frames are visually reviewed, with only directory values masked.
